name: Toggle Case Converter
description: Swap the case of every letter in your text — uppercase becomes lowercase and vice versa, entirely in your browser.

faq.question: What does Toggle Case actually do?
faq.answer: Every individual letter's case is swapped — uppercase letters become lowercase and lowercase letters become uppercase. 'Hello World' becomes 'hELLO wORLD'. Numbers, spaces, and punctuation are unaffected.

faq.question: Is my text uploaded anywhere?
faq.answer: No — the conversion runs entirely in your browser with plain JavaScript. Nothing is sent to a server.
